game_text: Then punish me, Magistrate-sama. You have been holding that threat over me since the night I touched the wrong door. So use it.
tts_text: [angry] [firmly] Then punish me, Magistrate-sama. You have been holding that threat over me since the night I touched the wrong door. [short pause] So use it.

game_text: You demand my desk in front of a half-drowned clerk and a Miya witness. That was stupid, To-chan. It was also the moment you stopped being anyone else's.
tts_text: [coldly] [cruelly] You demand my desk in front of a half-drowned clerk and a Miya witness. That was stupid, To-chan. [short pause] It was also the moment you stopped being anyone else's.

game_text: I did not mean... I only thought you would never actually...
tts_text: [trembling] [breathless] I did not mean... [short pause] I only thought you would never actually...

game_text: ...would never dare. Go on, keep guessing.
tts_text: [firmly] [bitterly] ...would never dare. [short pause] Go on, keep guessing.

game_text: My office. My corridor. We are finished when I say the word, not when your nerve runs out.
tts_text: [coldly] [firmly] My office. My corridor. [short pause] We are finished when I say the word, not when your nerve runs out.

game_text: Rain beads along the canal rope. The clerk keeps his eyes on his wax tablet, learning early how not to see. Kaoru's hand closes on her elbow, an escort's grip and nothing kinder, and the compound takes them both.
tts_text: [calm] [softly] Rain beads along the canal rope. The clerk keeps his eyes on his wax tablet, learning early how not to see. [short pause] Kaoru's hand closes on her elbow, an escort's grip and nothing kinder, and the compound takes them both.

game_text: You begged for closed screens twice in one night. Congratulations. You will have them.
tts_text: [mockingly] [coldly] You begged for closed screens twice in one night. [short pause] Congratulations. You will have them.

game_text: Behind closed screens. You heard me perfectly well the first time.
tts_text: [firmly] [bitterly] Behind closed screens. You heard me perfectly well the first time.

game_text: The desk. Now. Before you confuse your appetite for my permission a second time.
tts_text: [sternly] [menacingly] The desk. Now. [short pause] Before you confuse your appetite for my permission a second time.

game_text: An empty witness note. A blank collar line. You have nothing to show me, and you do not get another hour to find it.
tts_text: [coldly] [dismissive] An empty witness note. A blank collar line. [short pause] You have nothing to show me, and you do not get another hour to find it.

game_text: Magistrate-sama... let me make one more pass at the canal, please...
tts_text: [pleading] [trembling] Magistrate-sama... [short pause] let me make one more pass at the canal, please...

game_text: The desk. You are about to learn what my hall charges a witness who comes back with nothing to sign.
tts_text: [coldly] [menacingly] The desk. [short pause] You are about to learn what my hall charges a witness who comes back with nothing to sign.

game_text: You wanted theater out on the canal. This office is not a stage, To-chan. It is a desk, a seal, and the consequences of everything you said in front of witnesses.
tts_text: [coldly] [cruelly] You wanted theater out on the canal. This office is not a stage, To-chan. [short pause] It is a desk, a seal, and the consequences of everything you said in front of witnesses.

game_text: Magistrate-sama, I am your witness. I am not your...
tts_text: [trembling] [pleading] Magistrate-sama, I am your witness. [short pause] I am not your...

game_text: You are a line item on my evening until I decide otherwise. The desk. Now.
tts_text: [coldly] [dismissive] You are a line item on my evening until I decide otherwise. [short pause] The desk. Now.

game_text: Cedar and ink. The docket stack is still warm from Case One. His hanko sits beside a narrow custody chit, companion escort, temporary, the kind of paper that buys silence from clerks who have already learned not to hear.
tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Cedar and ink. The docket stack is still warm from Case One. [short pause] His hanko sits beside a narrow custody chit, companion escort, temporary, the kind of paper that buys silence from clerks who have already learned not to hear.

game_text: You pushed me twice at the waterline and once inside my own hall. I gave you the warnings. I do not give them a fourth time.
tts_text: [coldly] [menacingly] You pushed me twice at the waterline and once inside my own hall. [short pause] I gave you the warnings. I do not give them a fourth time.

game_text: Let me through... I am not one of your...
tts_text: [breathless] [pleading] Let me through... [short pause] I am not one of your...

game_text: You carried my seal's work into Scorpion water and walked back through that gate proud of it. Pride does not survive this room. It bends.
tts_text: [coldly] [cruelly] You carried my seal's work into Scorpion water and walked back through that gate proud of it. [short pause] Pride does not survive this room. It bends.

game_text: His hand closes around her wrist. Not a lover's hold, a magistrate's. His fingers find the pulse there the way they find a misplaced line in a ledger, precise and without any warmth at all.
tts_text: [softly] [calm] His hand closes around her wrist. Not a lover's hold, [short pause] a magistrate's. His fingers find the pulse there the way they find a misplaced line in a ledger, precise and without any warmth at all.

game_text: Let go of me...!
tts_text: [angry] [trembling] Let go of me...!

game_text: A witness without obedience is just gossip in a clean kosode. Learn the difference faster.
tts_text: [cruelly] [mockingly] A witness without obedience is just gossip in a clean kosode. [short pause] Learn the difference faster.

game_text: The mat comes up to meet her. Paper scatters across the floor like startled herons. The permit book skids under the desk, exactly where he had wanted it all along.
tts_text: [calm] [dramatic] The mat comes up to meet her. Paper scatters across the floor like startled herons. [short pause] The permit book skids under the desk, exactly where he had wanted it all along.

game_text: ...Get up. Crane girls get up. Please get up.
tts_text: [trembling] [whispers] ...Get up. Crane girls get up. [short pause] Please get up.

game_text: Her arms do not answer her. The pride was only ever a costume, and it has slipped off. Underneath it she is nothing but ragged breath and a bruised obi and the taste of his corridor.
tts_text: [softly] [sad] Her arms do not answer her. The pride was only ever a costume, and it has slipped off. [short pause] Underneath it she is nothing but ragged breath and a bruised obi and the taste of his corridor.

game_text: There. Now you are low enough to hear my terms properly.
tts_text: [coldly] [cruelly] There. [short pause] Now you are low enough to hear my terms properly.

game_text: The office door slides shut and seals. The lamplight narrows to a single thin strip under the shoji.
tts_text: [softly] [calm] The office door slides shut and seals. [short pause] The lamplight narrows to a single thin strip under the shoji.

game_text: Out in the hall, the clerks hear nothing. Or they teach themselves to hear nothing. It is filed as Emerald Magistrate business, and that is the end of it.
tts_text: [calm] [bitterly] Out in the hall, the clerks hear nothing. [short pause] Or they teach themselves to hear nothing. It is filed as Emerald Magistrate business, and that is the end of it.

game_text: You will knock on my screen again, the night your hunger finally outvotes your pride. Tonight, though, I collect what you owed me back at the canal.
tts_text: [coldly] [cruelly] You will knock on my screen again, the night your hunger finally outvotes your pride. [short pause] Tonight, though, I collect what you owed me back at the canal.

game_text: What happens after the lamp dies is entered in no clerk's ledger. It is recorded only in the ache she will carry out of this room, if she lives through the night to carry anything at all.
tts_text: [softly] [dramatic] What happens after the lamp dies is entered in no clerk's ledger. [long pause] It is recorded only in the ache she will carry out of this room, if she lives through the night to carry anything at all.

game_text: She boards alone, proud and quick, certain the manifest is a prize waiting for her and not a hook waiting for a fish.
tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] She boards alone, proud and quick, [short pause] certain the manifest is a prize waiting for her and not a hook waiting for a fish.

game_text: The factor does not run. He only smiles and steps out from under the awning, and somewhere behind her the deckhand's pole finds the small of her back.
tts_text: [calm] [menacingly] The factor does not run. He only smiles and steps out from under the awning, [short pause] and somewhere behind her the deckhand's pole finds the small of her back.

game_text: Then cold canal water, sweet with opium, closing over her head. The last thing she sees is Scorpion grey paint blistering and bubbling under the rain.
tts_text: [softly] [dramatic] Then cold canal water, sweet with opium, closing over her head. [long pause] The last thing she sees is Scorpion grey paint blistering and bubbling under the rain.

game_text: She walks out into the rain with her chin high, certain the magistrate will call her name before she reaches the third bridge.
tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] She walks out into the rain with her chin high, [short pause] certain the magistrate will call her name before she reaches the third bridge.

game_text: He never does. The factor's runners are the ones who call out to her instead. The companion file closes quietly, without her signature on the last line.
tts_text: [calm] [bitterly] He never does. The factor's runners are the ones who call out to her instead. [short pause] The companion file closes quietly, without her signature on the last line.

game_text: She lunges in alone, all pride and clean Crane footwork, hungry to prove the Academy still owns her blade.
tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] She lunges in alone, all pride and clean Crane footwork, [short pause] hungry to prove the Academy still owns her blade.

game_text: Kurogane's cut is plain dock arithmetic, not the theater she trained for. The rain swallows the pier whole. The magistrate's file closes, and her breath is not on the next page.
tts_text: [calm] [dramatic] Kurogane's cut is plain dock arithmetic, not the theater she trained for. The rain swallows the pier whole. [long pause] The magistrate's file closes, and her breath is not on the next page.

game_text: She fights the throw, all that Crane pride pitched against a hull that was only ever built for fishermen. Her shoulder and ribs meet the thwart at the wrong angle. The breath goes out of her. The kobune keeps rocking on the swell as if it had witnessed nothing at all.

game_text: Bandages, later. Rain against the shoji. A magistrate's shadow waits out at the marina pilings and never once crosses the gunwale, as though grief were something that might smudge a ledger.
tts_text: [softly] [sad] Bandages, later. Rain against the shoji. [short pause] A magistrate's shadow waits out at the marina pilings and never once crosses the gunwale, as though grief were something that might smudge a ledger.

game_text: The hospital cart creaks off toward the lower quarter. Ryoko Owari always keeps its boats. It does not always trouble itself to keep its dancers.
tts_text: [calm] [bitterly] The hospital cart creaks off toward the lower quarter. Ryoko Owari always keeps its boats. [short pause] It does not always trouble itself to keep its dancers.

game_text: She walks into the kiln alley a step ahead of him, ash smeared in her palms, the proof ready in her mouth, the pride still in every stride.
tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] She walks into the kiln alley a step ahead of him, ash smeared in her palms, [short pause] the proof ready in her mouth, the pride still in every stride.

game_text: The clerk's knife was never meant for Kaoru. It was meant for the dancer who would not let the Academy packet stay buried.
tts_text: [calm] [menacingly] The clerk's knife was never meant for Kaoru. [short pause] It was meant for the dancer who would not let the Academy packet stay buried.

game_text: Tsubaki's ghost gets company tonight. Toa's charter burns in the kiln with the rest of the evidence.
tts_text: [softly] [bitterly] Tsubaki's ghost gets company tonight. [short pause] Toa's charter burns in the kiln with the rest of the evidence.

game_text: The bolt roll catches her shoulder first, then the mat comes up, then the whole world tilts the wrong way. Crane footwork was never armor against a room built for the express purpose of killing witnesses.

game_text: Bandages, after. Rain against the shoji. A magistrate's shadow stands in the doorway and never crosses the threshold, as though grief were something that might be catching on a ledger.
